Interface GameObserver

All Known Subinterfaces:
GamePersistenceManager
All Known Implementing Classes:
RMIClientHandler, SerialGamePersistenceManager, SocketClientHandler, VirtualClient
public interface GameObserver
Observer for in-game state changes. Implemented by VirtualClient to push updates to connected clients and by GamePersistenceManager to persist state on each change.
